Question 3
?

A=[2101−20002] Consider the matrix A above. Which of the following represents the corresponding quadratic form xTAx in terms of the components of x=[x1x2x3]?

a
2x12+2x1x2−2x22+2x32
b
x12+2x1x3+2x22−2x32
c
2x12+2x1x2−2x22
d
2x22+2x1x2−2x32
e
2x12+2x1x2+2x32
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Method 1

Each entry aij of A corresponds to the term aijxixj in the expression of the quadratic form:

xTAx=2x1x1+1x1x2+0x1x3+1x2x1+(−2)x2x2+0x2x3+0x3x1+0x3x2+2x3x3=2x12+x1x2+x2x1−2x22+2x32=2x12+2x1x2−2x22+2x32

Method 2

To write down a quadratic form in terms of vector components, we compute the following expression:

xTAx=[x1x2x3][2101−20002][x1x2x3]=[x1x2x3][2x1+x2x1−2x22x3]=x1(2x1+x2)+x2(x1−2x2)+x3(2x3)=2x12+x1x2+x2x1−2xx2+2x32=2x12+2x1x2−2x22+2x32
